checks.text: Before it is checked the shop can cancel at once
After checking, the shop can only ask: "Cancellation requested. Waiting for our staff."
The owner is told the shop wants to cancel
And can keep the order or cancel it

shots.caption: 1. Cancelled before it was checked: it simply goes
2. Cancelled after it was checked: staff must agree
The owner sees the request and decides

did: Sent three orders and cancelled each at a different moment: before the owner checked it, after it was checked, and the owner pressed "Not collected" on one nobody came for.
